title: SvgRect
responsibility: Renders the native rect element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgRect.attributes
inputs.description: Native rect attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgRect.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native rect element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgRect
outputs.description: The actual native rect element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
